Implemented a public lobby search system.

notes.title: Update v0.0014 - Network Optimization and Bugfixes !
notes.content:
Improvements

Network performance has been optimized.

General optimizations were made to improve FPS.

Fixes

Fixed a bug that prevented the settings menu from appearing.

Fixed an issue that blocked character costumes from loading.

notes.title: Update v0.0012 - Spectator Mode and Ban System
notes.content:
Spectator Mode & Ban System

Added Spectator Mode so that you can now watch the other players.

Introduced a new Ban System that allows you to ban/unban other players.

Network Improvements

Lobby join errors now display clear error messages.

General network stability improvements.

Gameplay & UI Tweaks

You can now hide player avatars in the game.

Camera movement is now smoother.

Visual & Content Cleanup

All AI-generated logos and Steam capsule artworks have been removed from both the game and Steam pages.

Map Fixes

Mountain Easy map became easier.

Thanks again for playing and your feedback keeps making this game even better!

notes.title: Update v0.0011 - Localization, New Content & UI Improvements
notes.content:
Localization Updates
Added support for Polish, Czech, Russian, and Portuguese - Brazil.

Fixed missing characters in Korean and Chinese languages.

Added a language selection button in the Settings menu.
 Gameplay & UI Improvements
A message now appears in the top-left corner when a player dies.

Added a tutorial map to help new players.

Added an extra map to Demo version.

Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming!
